svg.aria-label: Relate schema of the graph, data/prometheus.rl: 123 Field nodes (code, title, firstYear, nPatents, genome with a vector index) linked by COMBINED_WITH (4,138, firstYear and count), BUILDS_ON (9,639, firstYear and count) and CO_CLASSIFIED (4,943, firstYear); 6,021 FieldYear nodes with patents per field per year; one Meta node. The per-year capsules use the same schema cut at their year, blinded.
